name: libheif
description: libheif is an HEIF and AVIF file format decoder and encoder. CEYX OVERLAY FORK: adds a `kvazaar` feature (BSD-3-Clause HEVC encoder) that upstream vcpkg does not carry — its only HEVC encoder feature is GPL-2.0 x265, excluded by this project (K3).

aom.description: AVIF decoding and encoding via aom

kvazaar.description: HEVC encoding via kvazaar (BSD-3-Clause). Ceyx-only feature; not present upstream.
